tax.text: Liu says he will oppose tax increases and reduce regulatory barriers to put more money back in residents’ pockets.
tax.quote: I will fight tax hikes, remove bureaucratic barriers, and put money back in your pocket.

safety.text: Liu says he will support police and hold criminals accountable as part of his public-safety agenda.
safety.quote: I will hold criminals accountable, back the police, and introduce humane but effective solutions to homelessness.
